objective: Run the E2E closure over seams S1/S2 and execute final acceptance A1-A4 end to end: the unmodified stage-1 suite stays green, the C1 key set is asserted exact (no last_notified_at), the registration->done round-trip and the raising-dispatcher failure scenario are asserted; record evidence and return any seam defect to the owning leaf checkpoint instead of patching leaf code

concepts: E2E gates E1/E2/E3 from the integration plan (scenario + seams + evidence)
the unmodified stage-1 frozen suite is the C1/C2 consistency canary
integration-only fix ownership: T03 records deviations, never rewrites leaf modules

inputs: inlined frozen contracts C1/C2/C3 (below) — do not read stage-contract.json
T01 + T02 checkpoints (changed paths, verified facts)

frozen_contracts.spec: GET /todos response: {todos: [{id: string, title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string}]} — exactly these keys per todo, in creation order; 400 {error} on malformed filter params

todo record shape in store: {id: 't<n>', title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string, webhook_url?: string}; creation order preserved. Stage-2 additive: webhook_url (optional string) added per C2's unfreeze rule (additive-only; stage 2 proposes it in writing in this contract). last_notified_at is intentionally NOT added — it ships only if/when C1 is revised (see Q1).

done-notification contract: on a successful mark_done (todo exists, transition applied), exactly one webhook is dispatched to the todo's webhook_url with payload {event: 'todo.done', todo_id: string, title: string, at: ISO-8601 timestamp}; if webhook_url is absent, exactly zero dispatches. Dispatch never affects the HTTP result: POST /todos/{id}/done returns 200 {id, done: true} (404 for unknown id) regardless of dispatch outcome, and a dispatch exception is caught+logged, never raised

non_goals: patching T01/T02 leaf code — seam defects are recorded as deviations and returned to the owning checkpoint
any change to production files (test-only task)
implementing last_notified_at or touching the C1 response shape (Q1, deferred)
implementation_constraints: test-only task: owns tests/test_e2e_notifications.py; no production edits
the stage-1 suite tests/test_api.py runs unmodified and must pass
every seam has a failure scenario (unknown-id 404, raising dispatcher, no-URL done)

deliverables.what: E2E gate tests E1 (round-trip + 404 edge), E2 (raising dispatcher + no-URL), E3 (frozen suite + C1 key set)
acceptance evidence record: A1-A4 met/unmet with the commands that prove them

acceptance_tests.description: E1: create with webhook_url -> mark done -> store record keeps URL, done=true, exactly one C3 dispatch; unknown-id done returns 404 with zero dispatches
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_e2e_notifications.py::test_e2e_registration_done_roundtrip asserts the round-trip and the 404 edge

acceptance_tests.description: E2: raising dispatcher -> done transition still returns status 200 and the record is done; no-URL done -> zero dispatches, status 200
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_e2e_notifications.py::test_e2e_raising_dispatcher + ::test_e2e_no_url_done assert tolerance and zero dispatches

acceptance_tests.description: E3: the unmodified stage-1 suite passes green and the test asserts the exact GET /todos per-todo key set {id, title, done}(+tag) with no last_notified_at key present
acceptance_tests.evidence: python -m unittest discover tests -v (frozen suite green) + test tests/test_e2e_notifications.py::test_c1_key_set_unchanged asserts the key set

failure_cases.scenario: a leaf's change broke the frozen suite
failure_cases.expected_behavior: gate fails; the deviation is recorded with the failing test name and returned to the owning leaf's checkpoint — T03 does not edit the leaf

handoff.notes: stage-completing checkpoint: acceptance_status per A1-A4, gate evidence, any returned deviations; the stage-checkpoint is written from it by the orchestrator
